messages:
Anika: Quick preflight — Valence private cutover tomorrow 09:00 PT. Can folks post status + any blockers we need to hit the 09:00 canary window? Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/valence-private-cutover :point_right:

Raj: Network owner here. Peering request approved but still waiting on their infra to confirm NAT64 mapping for 10.12.0.0/22 -> 34.56.78.0/24. If that mapping isn't live we fail health checks. I've pinged their network on the ticket (NET-1274).

Sophie: Security checklist: KMS keys provisioned, audit logs shipping, certs issued by our CA — I need confirmation that the customer-provided CA bundle was uploaded to the secret-store. If not, we generate a temp cert which they won't accept.

Liam: Noted on image sync: preprod images are failing to rsync through their proxy. I filed INC-4431. Quick workaround is to push images via our S3 mirror. Will try an rsync over SSH fallback: ```rsync -avz -e 'ssh -o ProxyCommand="nc -x proxy:3128 %h %p"' ./images/ valence@10.12.0.5:/var/lib/containerd/images/```

Tess: Customer ops update: Valence infra said they'll accept inbound peering by 08:30 PT and schedule a follow-up call at 08:40 to confirm. Legal is reviewing the data-handling appendix, ETA EOD.

deploy-bot: Preflight job queued: valence-cutover-preflight (job id: pf-2026-04-12-78). Checks: runbook, network, certs, image-sync. ETA ~5m.

Raj: Quick ask — I changed the network policy to allow library egress for the image pull (PR #4125). Can someone from infra + sec give a quick LGTM? It's a one-line allow for 34.56.78.0/24 -> 443.

Anika: I'll take ownership of coordinating reviews. @Liam can you review #4125? @Sophie confirm security side? Need final sign-off by 08:45 PT so ops can start canary at 09:00. :eyes:

Liam: On it, will review in 10m and do the rsync test after. If PR looks good, I'll merge and trigger the preflight.

Sophie: Reviewing now. CA bundle is still missing from secret-store under `valence/ca-bundle.pem`. If @Tess can confirm the upload or we should pull from their SFTP. Prefer vault path: `s3://redwood-secrets/valence/` is temporary but acceptable.

Anika: OK — action items: (1) @Tess confirm CA bundle location, (2) @Liam review+merge #4125 and run rsync fallback, (3) @Raj confirm NAT mapping propagating. Everyone reply if you hit new blockers before 08:45. :rocket:

Tess: Confirmed — CA bundle uploaded to s3://valence-artifacts/ca-bundle.pem and I've DM'd legal about the SLA. Will update ticket NET-1274 when NAT shows as active on their side.

Liam: PR #4125 LGTM, merged. Ran rsync fallback successfully to 10.12.0.5. Preflight job passed image-sync check.

Sophie: Security double-check passed: KMS key rotation window is set, CA chain validated against our CA. No outstanding sec blockers.

Raj: NAT mapping showing active as of 08:37 PT. Health checks from staging -> prod are green.

Anika: Amazing — that's everything I needed. I'll kick off the canary at 09:00 PT per runbook. If anything pops up, post here; otherwise proceed with cutover timeline. Thanks team :tada:
